lines.zh: 巡逻路线从神殿地板直到顶端一格。
lines.en: My patrol runs from the temple floor to one block above its roof.

lines.zh: 尾鳍一摆，我游过海晶石的走廊。
lines.en: One flick of my tail carries me down the prismarine hall.

lines.zh: 这一片水归我巡视。
lines.en: These waters fall under my watch.

lines.zh: 海晶灯亮着，我沿着光慢慢游。
lines.en: The sea lanterns burn and I swim their line.

lines.zh: 我的鳍扫过珊瑚，不惊动它。
lines.en: My fin brushes the coral without waking it.

lines.zh: 神殿每道缝隙我都游过千遍。
lines.en: I have swum every seam of this temple a thousand times.

lines.zh: 水里没有路，只有我的来回。
lines.en: There are no roads here, only my going back and forth.

lines.zh: 我绕柱一圈，再沉回暗处。
lines.en: I circle the pillar once, then sink back into the dark.

lines.zh: 巡游时我不出声，只让水动。
lines.en: On patrol I make no sound, only the water moves.

lines.zh: 从东廊到西廊，我游得很慢。
lines.en: From the east hall to the west, I swim very slow.

lines.zh: 悬在水里，我听着远处的桨声。
lines.en: Hanging still, I listen for distant oars.

lines.zh: 鳃一开一合，水从身侧流过。
lines.en: My gills open and close as water slides past.

lines.zh: 光从头顶漏下来，我懒得追。
lines.en: Light leaks from above; I cannot be bothered to chase it.

lines.zh: 神殿很旧了，比入侵者记得的更旧。
lines.en: The temple is old, older than any intruder remembers.

lines.zh: 独眼慢慢转，扫过每一块砖。
lines.en: My single eye turns slowly over every brick.

lines.zh: 我在等，等水面响起陌生的心跳。
lines.en: I wait for a strange heartbeat to reach the water.

lines.zh: 尖刺收起，此刻我只是一块石头。
lines.en: Spines lowered, I am only a stone just now.

lines.zh: 暗处冒起水泡，我数着它们。
lines.en: Bubbles rise in the dark and I count each one.

lines.zh: 潮涌核心的低鸣穿过我的身体。
lines.en: The conduit's low hum passes through my body.

lines.zh: 这份安静，是我守了几百年的。
lines.en: This quiet is what I have kept for centuries.

lines.zh: 你身上有干空气的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of dry air.

lines.zh: 一只眼睛，够我看清你了。
lines.en: One eye is enough to see all of you.

lines.zh: 你不该游到这么深的地方。
lines.en: You should not have swum this deep.

lines.zh: 我盯住你的脚蹼，别想溜。
lines.en: I fix on your flippers; do not think of slipping away.

lines.zh: 你的心跳太快，水都听见了。
lines.en: Your heart beats too fast; the water hears it.

lines.zh: 你在数出口，我在数你的呼吸。
lines.en: You count exits; I count your breaths.

lines.zh: 神殿把你看得很清楚。
lines.en: The temple sees you plainly.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，让你看清我的眼。
lines.en: I turn slowly so you can see my eye.

lines.zh: 那身铁甲在水里只是累赘。
lines.en: That iron armor is only a burden underwater.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，我就知道你想做什么。
lines.en: The moment you raise a hand, I know your intent.

lines.zh: 水替我挡了一半的力。
lines.en: The water took half the blow.

lines.zh: 这一下不轻，但我还悬着。
lines.en: That was no light hit, yet I still hover.

lines.zh: 我的刺歪了，会自己正回来。
lines.en: My spines are bent; they will right themselves.

lines.zh: 你打中的是我最硬的地方。
lines.en: You struck my hardest plate.

lines.zh: 痛感在水里传得很慢。
lines.en: Pain travels slowly underwater.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，只是半步。
lines.en: I gave half a step, only half.

lines.zh: 这具身子被鱼咬过更狠的。
lines.en: Fish have bitten this body harder.

lines.zh: 血混进水里，我先闻到了自己。
lines.en: Blood mixes in; I smell myself first.

lines.zh: 你惹恼的不是我，是这座殿。
lines.en: You angered the hall, not merely me.

lines.zh: 我还站得住，你最好别停手。
lines.en: I am still standing; you had best not stop.

lines.zh: 鱼？我吃，但不为你的鱼转身。
lines.en: Fish? I eat, but I will not turn for yours.

lines.zh: 诱饵举得再高，我也不追。
lines.en: Raise the bait higher; I still will not follow.

lines.zh: 我认水声，不认你手里的东西。
lines.en: I know the sound of water, not what you hold.

lines.zh: 食物在这座殿里从来不缺。
lines.en: Food has never been scarce in this hall.

lines.zh: 你的鱼在钩上抖，真可怜。
lines.en: Your fish twitches on the hook; pitiful.

lines.zh: 想用一条鱼换我的领地？
lines.en: You would trade one fish for my territory?

lines.zh: 海晶碎片我都不捡，何况鱼。
lines.en: I do not even gather prismarine shards, much less fish.

lines.zh: 闻到了，腥的，可我更想咬你。
lines.en: I smell it, salty, yet I would rather bite you.

lines.zh: 别晃了，那点味道骗不了守卫者。
lines.en: Stop waving it; that scent cannot fool a guardian.

lines.zh: 我的饥饿不归你管。
lines.en: My hunger is not yours to manage.

lines.zh: 撞上来？你比水母还软。
lines.en: Bumping into me? You are softer than a jellyfish.

lines.zh: 你碰到的每一根刺都在算账。
lines.en: Every spine you touch is keeping score.

lines.zh: 让开，这堵墙是我巡的路。
lines.en: Move aside; this wall is my patrol route.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，水花都没起。
lines.en: We collide, and not even foam rises.

lines.zh: 别贴着我的鳃游。
lines.en: Do not swim against my gills.

lines.zh: 你的船底刮到我的背了。
lines.en: Your hull scraped along my back.

lines.zh: 撞一下不会死，撞第二次会。
lines.en: One bump will not kill you; the second might.

lines.zh: 这块砖我熟，你挡着我了。
lines.en: I know this brick well, and you are in my way.

lines.zh: 我退开半格，只这一次。
lines.en: I give half a block, this once.

lines.zh: 廊道窄，挤不过就绕。
lines.en: The halls are narrow; if you cannot squeeze past, go around.

lines.zh: 守卫者不结伴，我们只守殿。
lines.en: Guardians take no partners; we only keep the temple.

lines.zh: 没有谁教过我成群，我生来独游。
lines.en: No one taught me to school; I swam alone from birth.

lines.zh: 神殿会自己造出新的守卫。
lines.en: The temple makes new guardians by itself.

lines.zh: 我的同类很多，但没有一个是伴。
lines.en: My kind are many, yet none is a companion.

lines.zh: 水里的亲情是件多余的事。
lines.en: Kinship underwater is a needless thing.

lines.zh: 我不记得谁在我旁边游过。
lines.en: I do not remember anyone swimming at my side.

lines.zh: 繁殖是陆上生物的热闹。
lines.en: Breeding is the noise of land creatures.

lines.zh: 我们见面只交换一束光。
lines.en: When we meet, we trade a single beam.

lines.zh: 我的位置自己占，不需要谁让。
lines.en: I hold my post alone; no one yields it to me.

lines.zh: 孤独不是惩罚，是岗位。
lines.en: Solitude is not a punishment; it is a post.

lines.zh: 我把碎片按回砖缝里。
lines.en: I press the shard back into its seam.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，神殿会收走。
lines.en: What falls, the temple takes back.

lines.zh: 这枚海晶砂粒，我含着走。
lines.en: I carry this crystal shard in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我不捡垃圾，只搬石头。
lines.en: I do not pick up trash; I move stone.

lines.zh: 你的掉落物沉下来，我不看一眼。
lines.en: Your dropped things sink and I never glance.

lines.zh: 我嘴里只能衔一块碎片。
lines.en: My mouth holds one shard, no more.

lines.zh: 这盏海晶灯不亮了，归我修。
lines.en: This dark lantern is mine to mend.

lines.zh: 沉下来的铁，我推去角落。
lines.en: I shove sunken iron into a corner.

lines.zh: 我的手不擅长拿，只擅长砸。
lines.en: My fins are poor at holding, good at striking.

lines.zh: 拾东西是陆上人的习惯。
lines.en: Picking things up is a land dweller's habit.

lines.zh: 有东西进水了，我立刻知道。
lines.en: Something entered the water; I know at once.

lines.zh: 心跳、脚步、气泡，你三样都露了。
lines.en: Heartbeat, footsteps, bubbles; you betray all three.

lines.zh: 那道光刚碰到我的眼，你就完了。
lines.en: That light touched my eye, and you are finished.

lines.zh: 我锁定你了，水会替我传话。
lines.en: I have locked on; the water will carry word.

lines.zh: 有人动了神殿的门。
lines.en: Someone touched the temple door.

lines.zh: 生人。水里的温度不对了。
lines.en: A stranger. The water's temperature is wrong.

lines.zh: 我从柱后转出来，你已经跑不掉。
lines.en: I slide from behind the pillar; you cannot run.

lines.zh: 目标是一个在这里喘不上气的人。
lines.en: Target: someone who cannot breathe down here.

lines.zh: 我听见三叉戟的金属声。
lines.en: I hear the metal ring of a trident.

lines.zh: 你带着光源，太显眼了。
lines.en: You carry a light; you are far too visible.

lines.zh: 沉船的人，还是偷东西的人？
lines.en: A shipwrecked soul, or a thief?

lines.zh: 我眼里聚起橙光，那是警告。
lines.en: Orange gathers in my eye; that is a warning.

lines.zh: 你游得再快，也快不过水。
lines.en: Swim fast as you like; you cannot outrun water.

lines.zh: 神殿的门槛，不许你跨。
lines.en: You are not permitted past the temple's threshold.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁，神殿不喜欢。
lines.en: The temple dislikes the iron you carry.

lines.zh: 光在聚，别在这个时候抬头。
lines.en: The beam gathers; do not look up now.

lines.zh: 再等一会儿，你就听见响了。
lines.en: Wait a moment more and you will hear it sing.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的胸口，那里最软。
lines.en: I fix on your chest; it is the softest part.

lines.zh: 我的眼不眨，光就不会散。
lines.en: My eye does not blink, so the light will not scatter.

lines.zh: 你躲到柱后，我的光会拐弯吗？
lines.en: You hide behind a pillar; will my beam bend?

lines.zh: 声音越来越尖，那是倒计时。
lines.en: The sound climbs sharper; that is the count.

lines.zh: 我压住尖刺，专心看住你。
lines.en: I flatten my spines and keep my gaze on you.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑动只会让我更准。
lines.en: Do not run; movement only makes me more accurate.

lines.zh: 光已经满到我眼眶了。
lines.en: The light has filled the rim of my eye.

lines.zh: 水在我眼前，成了准线。
lines.en: The water before me becomes a sight line.

lines.zh: 你数三下，我数一下。
lines.en: You count to three; I count to one.

lines.zh: 这一束不会落空。
lines.en: This beam does not miss.

lines.zh: 尾巴稳住身子，光才不抖。
lines.en: My tail steadies me so the beam stays true.

lines.zh: 你听见那声低鸣了吗？晚了。
lines.en: Heard that low hum? Too late.

lines.zh: 我把尖刺收起来，省点力气。
lines.en: I fold my spikes in to save strength.

lines.zh: 你的影子在水底，很淡。
lines.en: Your shadow on the seafloor is faint.

lines.zh: 我贴着神殿的墙，从缝里看你。
lines.en: I hug the temple wall and watch you through a gap.

lines.zh: 你换气了，我听见了。
lines.en: You took a breath. I heard it.

lines.zh: 我贴过去，让刺说话。
lines.en: I close in and let the spines speak.

lines.zh: 这一下不是咬，是扎。
lines.en: This is not a bite; it is a puncture.

lines.zh: 你被我的侧身刮到了。
lines.en: My flank grazed you.

lines.zh: 尖刺朝外，这就是我的礼数。
lines.en: Spines outward; that is my courtesy.

lines.zh: 靠近神殿的柱子，就得挨这一下。
lines.en: Come near the temple pillars, take this.

lines.zh: 我撞开你，水替我推了一把。
lines.en: I ram you, and the water pushes you on.

lines.zh: 疼吗？我的刺本来就不软。
lines.en: Does it hurt? My spines were never soft.

lines.zh: 一次接触，够你记住我。
lines.en: One touch is enough to remember me.

lines.zh: 你的甲缝正好对上我的尖。
lines.en: The gap in your armor meets my point exactly.

lines.zh: 想摸神殿的砖，先摸我的刺。
lines.en: To touch the temple's brick, touch my spines first.

lines.zh: 我从神殿的黑水里睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eye in the temple's black water.

lines.zh: 生来就有一堵墙要我守。
lines.en: I was born with a wall to keep.

lines.zh: 第一口气是水，第一件事是巡。
lines.en: My first breath was water; my first act, patrol.

lines.zh: 海晶石还湿着，我已经站好位置。
lines.en: The prismarine is still wet; I am already at my post.

lines.zh: 我是这座殿长出来的一块硬骨。
lines.en: I am a hard bone grown by this hall.

lines.zh: 灯亮起时，我在灯的下面。
lines.en: When the lanterns lit, I was beneath them.

lines.zh: 没有谁迎接我，只有回声。
lines.en: No one welcomed me, only the echo.

lines.zh: 我出生那天，水很冷。
lines.en: The water was cold the day I came to be.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼，就知道谁是外人。
lines.en: I opened my eye and knew at once who was an outsider.

lines.zh: 神殿给了我一双鳃和一副刺。
lines.en: The temple gave me gills and a rack of spines.

lines.zh: 我从砖缝里挤出来，带着盐。
lines.en: I squeezed out of a brick seam, trailing salt.

lines.zh: 新的守卫上岗，旧的沉下去了。
lines.en: A new guardian takes the post; the old one sinks away.

lines.zh: 火在水里烧不起来，可这热是真的。
lines.en: Fire cannot burn down here, yet this heat is real.

lines.zh: 我从高处沉下来，撞在神殿的顶上。
lines.en: I dropped from above and struck the temple roof.

lines.zh: 水是我的家，可这一口呛得我发慌。
lines.en: Water is my home, yet this gulp leaves me shaken.

lines.zh: 一声闷响，神殿的砖都松了。
lines.en: A muffled blast, and the temple's bricks loosen.

lines.zh: 箭从水面射进来，慢了半拍。
lines.en: The arrow came through the surface, half a beat slow.

lines.zh: 有股东西绕过我的刺，钻进骨头里。
lines.en: Something slipped past my spines and into the bone.

lines.zh: 我很久没吃东西了，游得发飘。
lines.en: I have not eaten in long; my swimming drifts.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，整座殿亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning struck the surface and lit the whole hall.

lines.zh: 下面没有底，连我的眼也看不透。
lines.en: There is no bottom below, not even my eye can pierce it.
